standards.requirement_zh: 公告 1.3、1.4、1.5 对项目目的、三层范围、设计任务和成果深度提出主控要求。
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单

standards.evidence_summary_zh: 三层范围、任务边界、重点区和成果深度逐项对应公告；临时几何不替代官方红线。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The three scopes, task boundary, key areas, and deliverable depth are traced to the announcement; provisional geometry never substitutes for official redlines.

standards.requirement_zh: 面向智能体任务书对十条共创原则、三大定位、五大功能、六项智能体任务、表达完整性和统一边界条款提出要求。

standards.evidence_summary_zh: 六项智能体任务由案例表、遗址公园、AI场景、荣誉展示、组件库、活动品牌和采用路径形成可读交付。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The six agent tasks are made readable through the case table, heritage park, AI scenarios, honor display, component library, event brand, and adoption path.

standards.requirement_zh: 城市设计应落实规划、指导建筑设计、塑造城市特色风貌，并统筹平面和立体空间。

standards.evidence_summary_en: Overall structure, public realm, building prototypes, and character controls are expressed as a concept/reference scheme with professional-development gates.

standards.requirement_zh: 控规深度相关结论必须区分已知控制条件、设计建议和待确认事项。

standards.evidence_summary_zh: 完整分区可复算；容积率、高度、红线、市政和消防条件保持未知，不以代理值冒充控规。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The complete partition is reproducible; FAR, height, redlines, utilities, and fire conditions remain unknown rather than being replaced by proxy controls.

standards.requirement_zh: 用地表达采用可校验用地分类和 land_use_code，不使用自造分类替代。

standards.evidence_summary_en: Land classification supports a gap-free reference partition and resistance-field semantics, explicitly not a statutory land-use plan.

standards.requirement_zh: 建筑专业深度规定待取得官方文件后启用；当前仅作为缺资料清单和深化提醒。

standards.evidence_summary_zh: 八个建筑原型仅表达拆改留与可逆首层接口；高度、结构、消防和工程做法待专业设计。
standards.evidence_summary_en: Eight building prototypes express retain/retrofit/remove logic and reversible ground-floor interfaces only; height, structure, fire safety, and engineering await professional design.

standards.requirement_zh: 《中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法》要求公共空间、公共服务与信息交流的无障碍建设与维护，并要求既有设施逐步改造。
proposal_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
重点区域详细设计
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 方案在具名章节提出连续无台阶通行链、维护责任与停止条件，并把无障碍作为试点的准入条件之一。这是设计阶段的承诺，不是条款级合规证明：确切条款适用性、现场测量与专业无障碍审查仍由 D07 与 D08 持有，`GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL` 与 `DB11-T-2209-2023-OFFICIAL` 目前均为 url_only_not_cleared，未产生任何标准派生结论。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The proposal states continuous step-free chains, maintenance duty, and stop conditions in named sections, and treats accessibility as an admission condition for each pilot. This is a design-stage commitment, not proof of clause-level compliance: exact clause applicability, survey, and professional accessibility review remain held by D07 and D08, and both GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL and DB11-T-2209-2023-OFFICIAL are url_only_not_cleared, so no standards-derived conclusion follows.

standards.requirement_zh: 国办发〔2020〕45号《关于切实解决老年人运用智能技术困难的实施方案》要求保留传统服务方式，不得以智能化为由拒绝提供人工或线下服务。
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 每个 P00–P11 行动都写明非数字替代方式，任何数字环节失效或被停止时，人工或线下服务继续可用。该条目是方案自设的运行约束，不构成对任何既有公共服务机构的合规结论。
standards.evidence_summary_en: Every P00-P11 action carries a non-digital fallback, so that human or offline service remains available whenever a digital step fails or is stopped. This is a self-imposed operating constraint of the proposal and constitutes no compliance conclusion about any existing public service body.

standards.requirement_zh: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》要求生成式人工智能服务实行分类分级管理，明确提供者责任、训练数据来源合法性、标识义务与投诉受理渠道。
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本方案自身不提供面向公众的生成式人工智能服务；它公开算法输入、运行记录与复算脚本，并为每个行动写明停机触发、授权人、回滚与申诉渠道。若未来试点确实部署此类服务，提供者责任、数据来源合法性与标识义务由该服务的运营方承担，本方案不代其承诺，相关授权事件由 D16 持有。
standards.evidence_summary_en: The package itself provides no public-facing generative AI service. It publishes algorithm inputs, run records, and a reproducer, and gives every action a stop trigger, an authorizing role, a rollback, and an appeal channel. If a pilot later deploys such a service, provider responsibility, lawfulness of training-data provenance, and labelling duties fall to that service's operator; this package makes no commitment on their behalf, and the authorizing event is held by D16.

standards.requirement_zh: 《建筑环境通用规范》GB 55019-2021 是自 2022-04-01 起施行的强制性国家规范，其条文对适用范围内的建筑与场地环境提出强制要求。
standards.mandatory_meaning_zh: 本矩阵的 `mandatory` 表示“本次提交必须作出的强制回应”。适用性未经具备资质的专业人员证实之前，本行取 `false`；这不改变 GB 55019-2021 自身作为强制性国家规范的法律性质，该性质记录在 `instrument_class_zh`。
standards.mandatory_meaning_en: In this matrix `mandatory` means "a mandatory response this submission must make". While applicability is unverified by a competent professional this row takes `false`; that says nothing about the legal character of GB 55019-2021 itself, which is recorded separately in `instrument_class_en`.
standards.gate_closure_effect_zh: 登记本行不关闭 `D07`。`D07` 需要合资格无障碍专业人员针对确切的已清权版本作出设计阶段条文适用性与路线审查，另需含仪器与分段结果的开放前实测审计；两者到位前，路线设计、equivalent text、`G5` 与公共开放保持 hold。
standards.gate_closure_effect_en: Registering this row does not close `D07`. `D07` requires a competent accessibility professional to review clause applicability and routes at design stage against the exact cleared edition, and a separate pre-opening instrumented audit with segment-level results. Until both exist, route design, equivalent text, `G5`, and public opening stay held.
proposal_sections: 指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
风险、版权与合规说明
standards.evidence_summary_zh: 本行只登记该强制性国家规范存在并自 2022-04-01 起施行。本包未持有已清权的条文正文（`cleared_clause_text_held: false`，`clauses_cited` 为空），因此不作条款适用性判断、不引用条文编号、不产生任何标准派生尺寸或合规结论。适用性字段保持未证实值并显式 cross-reference `D07`，`D07` 在 D 表中仍是无复选框的开放外部门。`GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL` 的本地状态为 url_only_not_cleared。
standards.evidence_summary_en: This row registers only that the mandatory national code exists and has been in force since 2022-04-01. The package holds no cleared clause text (`cleared_clause_text_held: false`, `clauses_cited` empty), so it makes no clause-applicability judgement, cites no clause number, and derives no dimension or compliance conclusion from the code. The applicability fields stay at unverified values and cross-reference `D07`, which remains a checkbox-free open external gate. The local state of `GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL` is url_only_not_cleared.

standards.designation_note_zh: `standard_id` 刻意省略正式名称中的斜杠以保持纯字母数字与连字符；带斜杠的正式名称保存在 `published_designation`。
standards.designation_note_en: The `standard_id` deliberately drops the solidus from the published designation so the identifier stays alphanumeric-and-hyphen; the published designation with its solidus is carried in `published_designation`.
standards.requirement_zh: DB11/T 2209-2023 是北京市地方标准，涉及慢行与道路相关的技术要求。
standards.mandatory_meaning_zh: 本矩阵的 `mandatory` 表示“本次提交必须作出的强制回应”。适用性未经具备资质的交通或慢行专业人员证实之前，本行取 `false`；本包亦未判断该地方标准属于推荐性还是强制性，该判断本身需要已清权版本，记录在 `instrument_class_zh`。
standards.mandatory_meaning_en: In this matrix `mandatory` means "a mandatory response this submission must make". While applicability is unverified by a competent mobility or transport professional this row takes `false`. The package also makes no determination of whether this local standard is recommended or compulsory, because that determination itself requires the cleared edition; see `instrument_class_en`.
standards.instrument_class_zh: 北京市地方标准；推荐性或强制性的判定未作，需已清权版本
standards.instrument_class_en: Beijing municipal local standard; whether it is recommended or compulsory is not determined here and requires the cleared edition
standards.gate_closure_effect_zh: 登记本行不关闭 `D08`。`D08` 需要具备资质的交通或慢行专业人员针对确切的已清权版本与所引条文作出书面适用性记录，并需有权道路或交通主管的书面管辖与合法道路通行权或过街决定；在此之前，所有触及道路、过街与慢行尺寸的成果保持 hold，任何展示面都不得出现 standards-applicability 声明或 standards-derived 尺寸。
standards.gate_closure_effect_en: Registering this row does not close `D08`. `D08` requires a competent mobility or transport professional to record applicability in writing against the exact cleared edition and the clauses cited, and a competent road or traffic authority to issue written jurisdiction and a lawful road right-of-way or crossing decision. Until then every artifact touching road, crossing, or walking-and-cycling dimensions stays held, and no publication surface may carry a standards-applicability claim or a standards-derived dimension.
